sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Crazy Balls is a racing game that requires you to navigate your ball through a variety of tracks while trying to avoid obstacles and collect power-ups. The gameplay is surprisingly simple, but don't let that fool you - it takes a surprising amount of skill and strategy to reach the top of the leaderboards. One of the key mechanics in Crazy Balls is the use of speed boosts, which can be obtained by swiping quickly and collecting power-ups. These speed boosts are essential for reaching the finish line before your opponents, and mastering them is key to success.

In addition to speed boosts, Crazy Balls also features a variety of obstacles and challenges that you'll need to navigate. These include gaps, tunnels, and even other balls that are trying to knock you off course. To overcome these obstacles, you'll need to use your wits and your reflexes to avoid taking damage and stay on track. It's a challenging but rewarding experience that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

As you progress through the game, you'll unlock new tracks, balls, and power-ups, each with its own unique abilities and challenges. This adds a significant amount of replay value to the game, as you'll need to adapt your strategy to suit each new track and ball. So don't be afraid to experiment and try new things - you never know what you might discover.
